mentions.name: teale.com
mentions.description: Distributed AI inference platform that pools networked devices' spare RAM into shared compute — like folding@home but sharing underutilized memory (while one device owner sleeps, someone else's device is awake and available). Also supports running distributed inference on a private network of company-owned devices.
mentions.problem: Device RAM sits underutilized; the project puts idle memory from networked devices to work for AI inference.
mentions.audience: Testers, plus companies interested in running distributed inference powered by their own devices on a private network; the author's company uses 200+ 16GB RAM machines this way.

mentions.name: Teale
mentions.description: Distributed AI inference pool that lets any Mac or iOS device contribute unused RAM to serve AI workloads, with device owners paid for contributing their spare memory. Priced at $0.05 per million tokens and includes multiplayer AI to help meet inference demand.
mentions.problem: Meeting high demand for AI inference compute by pooling unused RAM from Mac/iOS devices.
